Extracts response metadata from HTTP headers (etag, server, content-language)

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::scrape;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine = create_engine(None).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let url = r#"https://example.com"#.to_string();
    let _ = scrape(&engine, &url).await;
    println!("{:?}", result.status_code);
    println!("{:?}", result.response_meta.as_ref().unwrap().etag);
    println!("{:?}", result.response_meta.as_ref().unwrap().last_modified);
    println!("{:?}", result.response_meta.as_ref().unwrap().server);
    println!("{:?}", result.response_meta.as_ref().unwrap().content_language);
}
```
